{{Quote|Akk dogs are commonly seen as Jedi pets or companions. I first encountered these animals on Ord Canfre's ExplorCorps outpost, but didn't think there was anything unusual about the bond they shared with their trainers.|Jedi Master Bowspritz, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="JP" />}}
'''Ord Canfre''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]. Having served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later Ord Canfre hosted a facility of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]]. While there, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bowspritz]] first encountered [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic surrendered the world to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after the [[Battle of Ord Canfre]]. Ord Canfre came under the control of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, and its [[Ord Canfre system/Legends|star system]] was [[Battle of the Ord Canfre system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Ord Canfre was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> located in the [[Ord Canfre system/Legends|Ord Canfre system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a part of the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]<ref name="CSWE Cassandran">{{CSWECite|I|111|Cassandran Worlds}}</ref> that eventually became known as the [[Cassander subsector]], a [[Sector/Legends|part]] of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ord Canfre Surrenders|A CIS Shadowfeed headline|<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref>}}
[[File:AkkDog-TJP.png|thumb|right|300px|Jedi Bowspritz first encountered akk dogs (an akk dog pictured) at Ord Canfre.]]
Ord Canfre served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite the planet being located outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> At some point more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] maintained an outpost there. At the outpost, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bowspritz]] first encountered [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] creatures<ref name="JP" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="CSWE akk dog">{{CSWECite|I|16|akk dog}}</ref> the planet<ref name="CSWE HaruunKal">{{CSWECite|II|23|Haruun Kal}}</ref> [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].<ref name="CSWE akk dog" /> The akk dogs present at the Ord Canfre outpost had been domesticated, although at the time Bowspritz had not viewed the bond that the animals had shared with their trainers as anything unusual. The Jedi would later note that visit to Ord Canfre in the<ref name="JP" /> [[990 BBY]]<ref name="JPEndnotes1">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)}}</ref> [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="JP" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Republic force,<ref name="NEC" /> including a Jedi-[[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]] unit,<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> fought the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="NEC" /> in the [[Battle of Ord Canfre]], which would become known as a debacle.<ref name="GaW" /> The Republic was forced to<ref name="NEC" /> surrender the world<ref name="Insider65" /> to the Confederacy,<ref name="NEC" /> a fact that was noted in a headline of a [[22 BBY/Legends|14:2:14]] release of the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] news and [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] program.<ref name="Insider65" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Ord Canfre was still considered to be a Confederate-aligned world.<ref name="FF139" />

Ord Canfre was situated in the territory controlled by the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and it fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] from 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The Ord Canfre [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Battle of the Ord Canfre system|attacked]] by the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] system was still under the control of the invaders by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[36 ABY]], the Republic's loss of Ord Canfre during the Clone Wars was noted in a [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|document]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Canfre was first mentioned in "[[CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[CIS Shadowfeed (Insider)|in-universe news report]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 65|sixty-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider65" /> on [[January 21]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20021219.html|text=''Insider'' #65 & ''Bantha Tracks'' #2}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ord Canfre system, and therefore Ord Canfre itself, in grid square K-5.<ref name="TEA" />
